name: probegap
description: Check the httpGet and tcpSocket liveness, readiness and startup probes in Kubernetes manifests against the servers a Go program really starts: paths that return 404, 401 or 405, ports nothing listens on, servers bound to localhost, HTTP and HTTPS mismatches and named ports that don't exist. It runs the program with the container's args and env, opens no port, and sends the kubelet's request to the real handler.
